ko.L: 유다 왕 요시야의 아들 여호야김의 통치 초기에, 이 말씀이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다를 다스리기 시작했을 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 말씀을 주셨다.
ko.R: 요시야의 아들 여호야김이 유다의 왕이 된 지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 말씀을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the beginning of the reign: the first months of Jehoiakim's rule, before his first full year
decisions.reason: The phrase names the time between a king coming to the throne and the start of his first full year as king (27:1; 28:1; 49:34). Jehoiakim was made king by Pharaoh Necho after his brother Jehoahaz was taken to Egypt (2 Kings 23:34), about 609 BC.

decisions.choice: this word: the temple sermon given in full in 7:1-15
decisions.reason: Chapter 7 gives the sermon at length; this chapter gives a short summary of it (verses 2-6) and tells what happened to Jeremiah after he preached it. The warning about Shiloh, the call to change their ways and the words "rising early and speaking" appear in both.

decisions.choice: chapter 26 of the Hebrew is chapter 33 of the Greek translation
decisions.reason: Because the Greek translation (the Septuagint) places the oracles against the nations after 25:13, this chapter stands later there (see 1:1). The Greek is also somewhat shorter in this chapter. The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: this word came from the LORD, saying: (L); this message came from the LORD: (B); the LORD gave this message (R)
decisions.reason: The heading is close to the one set for Jeremiah (7:1), and is worded the same way at each level.

decisions.choice: When Jehoiakim ... had just become king
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the beginning of the reign" means (m1).

decisions.choice: narrative chapters (Jeremiah 26-29, 32-34): passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable, imparfait for repeated action
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the narrative chapters of Jeremiah, like Kings; speech inside them keeps the tenses of speech.

decisions.choice: "통치 초기에" (L); "다스리기 시작했을 때에" (B); "왕이 된 지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's pattern for dated headings ("X가 다스리던 때에", "X가 왕이었을 때에"), adapted to "the beginning of the reign" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Chapter 26 told as narrative prose, with speech in quotation marks
decisions.reason: As the terms note, the narrative chapters (most of 26-45) are prose; speech is quoted as prose does.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲמֹד֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהוָה֒ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֞ עַל־כָּל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה הַבָּאִים֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת בֵּית־יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖יךָ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אַל־תִּגְרַ֖ע דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: stand in [the] court of [the] house of Yahweh, and you will speak to all [the] cities of Judah the [ones] coming to bow down [at the] house of Yahweh all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them; not you hold back a word.

en.L: "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Stand in the court of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and speak to all the cities of Judah who come to bow down [at] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them; do not hold back a word.
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Take your stand in the courtyard of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house and speak to the people of all the towns of Judah who come to worship at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Tell them all the words I have commanded you to speak to them; do not hold back a single word.
en.R: "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Go and stand in the courtyard of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. People from all the towns of Judah come there to worship. Tell them everything I have commanded you to say to them. Do not leave out even one word.

es.L: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Ponte en el atrio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y habla a todas las ciudades de Judá que vienen a postrarse [en] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todas las palabras que te he mandado que les hables; no omitas ni una palabra.
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Ponte en el atrio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y habla a la gente de todas las ciudades de Judá que vienen a adorar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Diles todas las palabras que te he mandado decirles; no te calles ni una sola palabra.
es.R: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Ve y ponte en el patio del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí viene a adorar gente de todos los pueblos de Judá. Diles todo lo que te he mandado que les digas. No dejes fuera ni una sola palabra.

fr.L: « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Tiens-toi dans le parvis de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et dis à toutes les villes de Juda qui viennent se prosterner [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} toutes les paroles que je t’ai ordonné de leur dire ; n’en retranche pas un mot.
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Tiens-toi dans le parvis de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et parle aux gens de toutes les villes de Juda qui viennent adorer dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Dis-leur toutes les paroles que je t’ai ordonné de leur dire ; n’en retranche pas un seul mot.
fr.R: « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Va te tenir dans la cour du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Des gens de toutes les villes de Juda viennent y adorer. Dis-leur tout ce que je t’ai ordonné de leur dire. N’oublie pas un seul mot.

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Simama katika ua wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukaseme na miji yote ya Yuda wanaokuja kusujudu [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} maneno yote niliyokuamuru kuwaambia; usipunguze neno.
sw.B: "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Simama katika ua wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukawaambie watu wa miji yote ya Yuda wanaokuja kuabudu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Waambie maneno yote niliyokuamuru kuwaambia; usiache hata neno moja.
sw.R: "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nenda ukasimame katika ua wa hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu kutoka miji yote ya Yuda huja huko kuabudu. Waambie kila kitu nilichokuamuru uwaambie. Usiache hata neno moja.

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Hãy đứng trong sân nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nói với mọi thành của Giu-đa đến thờ lạy [tại] nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mọi lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho ngươi nói với chúng; đừng bớt một lời nào.
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Con hãy đứng trong sân nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói với dân của mọi thành Giu-đa đến thờ phượng tại nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy nói với họ mọi lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho con nói; đừng bớt một lời nào.
vi.R: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Con hãy đi đứng trong sân đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Dân từ mọi thành của Giu-đa đến đó thờ phượng. Hãy nói với họ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho con nói. Đừng bỏ sót một lời nào.

ko.L: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰에 서서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 경배하러 오는 유다의 모든 성읍 [사람들]에게 내가 너에게 말하라고 명령한 모든 말을 전하여라. 한 마디도 빼지 마라.
ko.B: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰에 서서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 예배하러 오는 유다 모든 성읍의 사람들에게 말하여라. 내가 너에게 명령한 말을 모두 그들에게 전하고, 한 마디도 빼놓지 마라.
ko.R: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 가서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 뜰에 서라. 유다의 모든 성읍에서 사람들이 그곳에 예배하러 온다. 내가 너에게 명령한 말을 모두 그들에게 전하여라. 한 마디도 빼놓지 마라.

decisions.choice: stand in the court of the house of the LORD: the place of the sermon in 7:2
decisions.reason: In 7:2 Jeremiah is told to stand in the gate of the house of the LORD. The gate led into the court, and both name the place where the crowds of worshipers came in. The temple had more than one court (1 Kings 6:36; 2 Kings 21:5); this is one where the people gathered.

decisions.choice: all the cities of Judah: the people from every town of Judah
decisions.reason: The towns stand for the people who live in them. Crowds from the whole country came to the temple, most of all at the festivals, so Jeremiah would be heard by all Judah.

decisions.choice: do not hold back a word: say all of it, leaving nothing out
decisions.reason: The verb means to take away from or make less. The Law uses it for adding to or taking away from God's commands (Deuteronomy 4:2; 13:1). Jeremiah must not soften the message to protect himself.

decisions.choice: cities (L); towns (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word covers walled places of any size. Most places in Judah were small, so Balanced and Readable say "towns".

decisions.choice: People from all the towns of Judah come there to worship. Tell them ...
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long command into short sentences.

decisions.choice: "nhà CHÚA" (L, B); "đền thờ CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Kings, "the house of the LORD" is "nhà CHÚA" at Literal and Balanced and "đền thờ" at Readable, through this narrative.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "... 이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "... 하시는 말씀이다" (R), with the honorific, though the formula stands inside God's words to Jeremiah
alternatives: "주가 이와 같이 말한다" (God naming himself plainly)
decisions.reason: One rule for Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezra: the messenger formula keeps the honorific even where God dictates the message, as published at 1 Kings 21:19, 2 Samuel 7:5 and 1 Chronicles 17:4; God's own words that follow stay in the plain style, without -시- for himself.

source.text: אוּלַ֣י יִשְׁמְע֔וּ וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה וְנִחַמְתִּ֣י אֶל־הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י חֹשֵׁב֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Perhaps they will listen and turn each from his way the evil, and I will relent concerning the disaster that I [am] planning to do to them because of [the] evil of their deeds.

en.L: Perhaps they will listen and turn, each from his evil way, and I will relent concerning the disaster that I am planning to do to them because of the evil of their deeds.
en.B: Perhaps they will listen and each one will turn from his evil way. Then I will relent concerning the disaster I am planning to bring on them because of their evil deeds.
en.R: Maybe they will listen. Maybe each of them will stop living in evil ways. If they do, I will change my mind about the disaster I am planning to bring on them because of the evil things they have done.

es.L: Quizás escuchen y se vuelvan cada uno de su mal camino, y yo me retracte del mal que pienso hacerles por la maldad de sus obras.
es.B: Quizás escuchen y cada uno se vuelva de su mal camino. Entonces desistiré del desastre que pienso traer sobre ellos por sus malas obras.
es.R: Tal vez escuchen. Tal vez cada uno de ellos deje de vivir en sus malos caminos. Si lo hacen, cambiaré de parecer acerca del desastre que pienso traer sobre ellos por las maldades que han hecho.

fr.L: Peut-être écouteront-ils et reviendront-ils chacun de sa mauvaise voie, et je renoncerai au malheur que je projette de leur faire à cause de la méchanceté de leurs actions.
fr.B: Peut-être écouteront-ils, et chacun se détournera-t-il de sa mauvaise conduite. Alors je renoncerai au malheur que je projette de faire venir sur eux à cause de leurs mauvaises actions.
fr.R: Peut-être qu’ils écouteront. Peut-être que chacun d’eux arrêtera de mal se conduire. S’ils le font, je changerai d’avis au sujet du malheur que je prévois de faire venir sur eux à cause du mal qu’ils ont fait.

sw.L: Huenda watasikiliza na kurudi, kila mtu kutoka njia yake mbaya, nami nitaghairi kuhusu maafa ninayokusudia kuwatendea kwa sababu ya uovu wa matendo yao.
sw.B: Huenda watasikiliza, na kila mmoja akarudi kutoka njia yake mbaya. Ndipo nitaghairi kuhusu maafa ninayokusudia kuwaletea kwa sababu ya matendo yao maovu.
sw.R: Huenda watasikiliza. Huenda kila mmoja wao ataacha kuishi katika njia mbaya. Wakifanya hivyo, nitabadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kuhusu maafa ninayopanga kuwaletea kwa sababu ya maovu waliyoyatenda.

vi.L: Có lẽ chúng sẽ nghe và quay lại, mỗi người khỏi đường ác của mình, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang định giáng trên chúng vì điều ác trong việc làm của chúng.
vi.B: Có lẽ họ sẽ nghe, và mỗi người sẽ quay lại khỏi đường ác của mình. Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang định giáng trên họ vì những việc làm gian ác của họ.
vi.R: Có thể họ sẽ nghe. Có thể mỗi người sẽ thôi sống theo đường lối gian ác. Nếu vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang định giáng trên họ vì những điều ác họ đã làm.

ko.L: 혹시 그들이 듣고 저마다 자기의 악한 길에서 돌아올지도 모른다. 그러면 내가 그들의 악한 행실 때문에 그들에게 내리려고 계획하는 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키겠다.
ko.B: 혹시 그들이 듣고 저마다 악한 길에서 돌아설지도 모른다. 그러면 나는 그들의 악한 행실 때문에 그들에게 내리려고 계획한 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키겠다.
ko.R: 혹시 그들이 들을지도 모른다. 혹시 저마다 악하게 사는 길에서 돌아올지도 모른다. 그렇게 하면, 나는 그들이 저지른 악한 일 때문에 내리려고 계획한 재앙에 대하여 마음을 바꾸겠다.

decisions.choice: I will relent: God will turn back from the punishment he has announced if the people turn back from their evil
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God changing what he has said he will do, out of pity or in answer to repentance (18:7-10; Exodus 32:14; Jonah 3:10). His warning is not a fixed fate but a call to change. Verses 13 and 19 come back to the same word.

decisions.choice: evil way ... disaster ... evil deeds: one word for the people's wrong and for the harm it brings
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word means both wickedness and disaster. If the people turn from their evil, God will turn from the evil he plans for them. The word comes back in verses 13 and 19.

decisions.choice: I am planning: the disaster is in God's mind but not yet carried out
decisions.reason: The participle describes something being planned now. God speaks as a potter shaping a plan that can still change (18:11).

decisions.choice: relent (L, B); change my mind (R)
decisions.reason: "Repent" would suggest God had done wrong. "Relent" and "change my mind" say that he holds back the punishment.

decisions.choice: bring on them
decisions.reason: Literally "to do to them"; Balanced uses the usual English phrase for causing a disaster.

decisions.choice: "đổi ý" (relent) at every level
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 18:8 and 26:13, 19; the English's "change my mind" at Readable is already what "đổi ý" says.

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י לָלֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will say to them, Thus says Yahweh: if not you listen to me to walk in my instruction that I have set before you,

decisions.choice: like Shiloh: the first place of the LORD's worship, which he let be destroyed

The tabernacle and the ark were at Shiloh in the days of Eli, but because of the sins of the priests the ark was captured and Shiloh was left behind (1 Samuel 4; Psalm 78:60). God's house in Jerusalem was no more safe from judgment than his place in Shiloh had been.

decisions.choice: make this city a curse: its fate will be so terrible that other nations use its name in curses

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Jérémie eut achevé de dire tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [lui] avait ordonné de dire à tout le peuple, que les prêtres, et les prophètes, et tout le peuple le saisirent, disant : « Tu mourras, tu mourras !
fr.B: Dès que Jérémie eut fini de dire tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait ordonné de dire à tout le peuple, les prêtres, les prophètes et tout le peuple se saisirent de lui et dirent : « Tu dois mourir !
fr.R: Jérémie a fini de dire au peuple tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait ordonné de dire. Alors les prêtres, les prophètes et tout le peuple l’ont attrapé. « Tu vas mourir pour cela ! » ont-ils dit.

sw.L: Ikawa, Yeremia alipokwisha kunena yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru kuwaambia watu wote, makuhani na manabii na watu wote wakamkamata, wakisema, "Hakika utakufa!
sw.B: Mara tu Yeremia alipomaliza kusema kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru awaambie watu wote, makuhani, manabii na watu wote walimkamata, wakasema, "Lazima ufe!
sw.R: Yeremia alimaliza kuwaambia watu kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru aseme. Ndipo makuhani, manabii na watu wote wakamkamata. Wakasema, "Lazima ufe kwa jambo hili!

vi.L: Khi Giê-rê-mi vừa nói xong mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền [cho ông] nói với toàn dân, thì các thầy tế lễ, các nhà tiên tri và toàn dân bắt ông mà nói: "Ngươi chắc chắn phải chết!
vi.B: Giê-rê-mi vừa nói xong mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho ông nói với toàn dân, thì các thầy tế lễ, các nhà tiên tri và toàn dân bắt ông và nói: "Ngươi phải chết!
vi.R: Giê-rê-mi nói xong với dân chúng mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho ông nói. Bấy giờ các thầy tế lễ, các nhà tiên tri và toàn dân túm lấy ông. Họ nói: "Ngươi phải chết vì việc này!"

ko.L: 그리고 예레미야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 백성에게 말하라고 [그에게] 명령하신 것을 다 말하자, 제사장들과 예언자들과 모든 백성이 그를 붙잡고 말했다. "너는 반드시 죽어야 한다!
ko.B: 예레미야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 백성에게 전하라고 명령하신 말씀을 다 전하자마자, 제사장들과 예언자들과 모든 백성이 그를 붙잡고 말했다. "너는 죽어야 한다!
ko.R: 예레미야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 전하라고 명령하신 말씀을 모든 백성에게 다 전했다. 그러자 제사장들과 예언자들과 모든 백성이 그를 붙잡았다. 그들이 말했다. "너는 이 일로 죽어야 한다!

decisions.choice: you will surely die: a death sentence, made emphatic by the doubled verb
decisions.reason: The verb is repeated, "dying you will die", as in Genesis 2:17 and 1 Samuel 14:44; 22:16. They do not merely threaten him; they pronounce him guilty.

decisions.choice: they seized him: they charged him as a false prophet
decisions.reason: The Law said that a prophet who spoke in the LORD's name what the LORD had not commanded must die (Deuteronomy 18:20). The irony is that Jeremiah had spoken all the LORD "had commanded" him, as the verse says.

decisions.choice: all the people: the crowd at first joins the priests and prophets
decisions.reason: By verse 16 the people side with the officials against the priests and prophets. The crowd's mood changes as the case is heard.

decisions.choice: You will surely die! (L); You must die! (B); You must die for this! (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the doubled verb with "surely"; Balanced and Readable say it as a sentence pronounced on him.

decisions.choice: "Tu mourras, tu mourras !" (L)
decisions.reason: French repeats the verb to keep the doubled Hebrew form, as the English Literal keeps it with "surely"; Balanced and Readable say it as a sentence pronounced on him.

decisions.choice: the accusers say "ngươi" to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Speaking to a man they treat as a criminal, the crowd uses the hostile "ngươi"; the narrator keeps "ông" for him.

decisions.choice: The crowd speaks to Jeremiah in 해라체 ("너는 ... 죽어야 한다")
decisions.reason: The priests, prophets and people seize him as a false prophet (meaning decision m2); as the style guide allows for open opponents, the hostile scene is in the plain style.

source.text: מַדּוּעַ֩ נִבֵּ֨יתָ בְשֵׁם־יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר כְּשִׁלוֹ֙ יִֽהְיֶה֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה וְהָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את תֶּחֱרַ֖ב מֵאֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֑ב וַיִּקָּהֵ֧ל כָּל־הָעָ֛ם אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Why have you prophesied in [the] name of Yahweh, saying, Like Shiloh will be the house this, and the city this will be desolate, without inhabitant? And was gathered all the people to Jeremiah in [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: Why have you prophesied in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying, 'This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant'?" And all the people gathered around Jeremiah in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Why have you prophesied in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will lie in ruins with no one living in it?" And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: "Why do you say in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s name that this temple will be like Shiloh? Why do you say this city will be destroyed and no one will live here?" All the people crowded around Jeremiah in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.

es.L: ¿Por qué has profetizado en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo: “Esta casa será como Silo, y esta ciudad quedará desolada, sin habitante”?». Y todo el pueblo se juntó alrededor de Jeremías en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¿Por qué has profetizado en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que esta casa será como Silo y que esta ciudad quedará en ruinas y sin nadie que viva en ella?». Y todo el pueblo se amontonó alrededor de Jeremías en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: «¿Por qué dices en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que este templo será como Silo? ¿Por qué dices que esta ciudad será destruida y que nadie vivirá aquí?». Todo el pueblo se amontonó alrededor de Jeremías en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Pourquoi as-tu prophétisé au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en disant : “Cette maison sera comme Silo, et cette ville sera dévastée, sans habitant” ? » Et tout le peuple s’attroupa autour de Jérémie dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Pourquoi as-tu prophétisé au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que cette maison serait comme Silo et que cette ville serait en ruines, sans personne pour y habiter ? » Et tout le peuple se pressa autour de Jérémie dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: « Pourquoi dis-tu au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que ce temple sera comme Silo ? Pourquoi dis-tu que cette ville sera détruite et que plus personne n’y habitera ? » Tout le peuple s’est attroupé autour de Jérémie dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa nini umetabiri kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukisema, 'Nyumba hii itakuwa kama Shilo, na mji huu utakuwa ukiwa, bila mkaaji'?" Na watu wote wakakusanyika kumzunguka Yeremia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa nini umetabiri kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwamba nyumba hii itakuwa kama Shilo na mji huu utakuwa magofu bila mtu wa kukaa ndani yake?" Na watu wote wakamzunguka Yeremia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: "Kwa nini unasema kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwamba hekalu hili litakuwa kama Shilo? Kwa nini unasema mji huu utaharibiwa na hakuna mtu atakayeishi hapa?" Watu wote wakamzunguka Yeremia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Sao ngươi nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói tiên tri rằng: 'Nhà này sẽ giống như Si-lô, và thành này sẽ hoang vu, không còn cư dân'?" Toàn dân xúm lại quanh Giê-rê-mi trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Sao ngươi nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói tiên tri rằng nhà này sẽ giống như Si-lô, và thành này sẽ hoang tàn, không còn ai ở?" Toàn dân xúm lại quanh Giê-rê-mi trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: "Sao ngươi nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nói rằng đền thờ này sẽ giống như Si-lô? Sao ngươi nói thành này sẽ bị tàn phá và không còn ai ở đây?" Toàn dân xúm lại quanh Giê-rê-mi trong đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 어찌하여 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 예언하여 '이 집이 실로처럼 되고, 이 성이 주민 없이 황폐해질 것이다.' 하고 말했느냐?" 그리고 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 예레미야를 둘러싸고 모여들었다.
ko.B: 어찌하여 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로, 이 집이 실로처럼 되고 이 성이 폐허가 되어 아무도 살지 않을 것이라고 예언했느냐?" 그리고 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 예레미야를 에워쌌다.
ko.R: "어찌하여 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 이 성전이 실로처럼 될 것이라고 말하느냐? 어찌하여 이 성이 망하고 아무도 여기에 살지 않을 것이라고 말하느냐?" 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 예레미야를 에워쌌다.

decisions.choice: prophesied in the name of the LORD: they deny that the LORD could say such a thing
decisions.reason: To speak in the LORD's name was to claim his authority. The priests and prophets cannot believe God would threaten his own house, so they treat Jeremiah's words as a false claim (Deuteronomy 18:20-22).

decisions.choice: desolate, without inhabitant: their summary of his message
decisions.reason: Verse 6 says the city will become a curse; the charge restates it in words Jeremiah uses elsewhere (4:7; 9:10). They give the gist of what he said.

decisions.choice: gathered around Jeremiah: the crowd pressed close around him
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean gathering to someone or against someone (Numbers 16:3). Here the crowd surrounds the prisoner, probably in a hostile mood (verse 8).

decisions.choice: two questions; the quotation opens again
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long question in two. Because its verse 8 closes the quotation after "they said", it opens it again here.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ׀שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיַּעֲל֥וּ מִבֵּית־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בְּפֶ֥תַח שַֽׁעַר־יְהוָ֖ה הֶחָדָֽשׁ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And heard [the] princes of Judah the things these, and they came up from [the] house of the king [to the] house of Yahweh, and they sat in [the] entrance of [the] gate of Yahweh the new.

en.L: And the princes of Judah heard these things, and they came up from the house of the king [to] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they sat at the entrance of the New Gate of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The officials of Judah heard about these things, and they came up from the royal palace to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and took their seats at the entrance of the New Gate of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house.
en.R: The leaders of Judah heard what was happening. So they went up from the king's palace to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. There they sat down at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple to hear the case.

es.L: Y los príncipes de Judá oyeron estas cosas, y subieron de la casa del rey [a] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y se sentaron a la entrada de la puerta Nueva {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los jefes de Judá se enteraron de estas cosas, y subieron del palacio real a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y se sentaron a la entrada de la puerta Nueva de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los dirigentes de Judá se enteraron de lo que estaba pasando. Así que subieron del palacio del rey al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí se sentaron a la entrada de la puerta Nueva del templo para oír el caso.

fr.L: Et les princes de Juda entendirent ces choses, et ils montèrent de la maison du roi [à] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils s’assirent à l’entrée de la porte Neuve {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les chefs de Juda apprirent ces choses ; ils montèrent du palais royal à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et siégèrent à l’entrée de la porte Neuve de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les chefs de Juda ont appris ce qui se passait. Alors ils sont montés du palais du roi au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Là, ils se sont assis à l’entrée de la porte Neuve du temple pour juger l’affaire.

sw.L: Na wakuu wa Yuda waliposikia mambo haya, wakapanda kutoka nyumba ya mfalme [mpaka] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakaketi penye maingilio ya Lango Jipya la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Maafisa wa Yuda waliposikia mambo haya, walipanda kutoka jumba la mfalme mpaka nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakaketi penye maingilio ya Lango Jipya la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Viongozi wa Yuda walisikia yaliyokuwa yakitokea. Basi wakapanda kutoka jumba la mfalme mpaka hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Huko wakaketi penye maingilio ya Lango Jipya la hekalu ili kusikiliza shauri hilo.

vi.L: Các quan trưởng Giu-đa nghe những việc ấy, thì họ đi lên từ cung vua [đến] nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ngồi tại lối vào Cổng Mới của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các quan chức Giu-đa nghe về những việc ấy, thì từ cung vua đi lên nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và ngồi tại lối vào Cổng Mới của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo Giu-đa nghe chuyện đang xảy ra. Vậy họ từ cung vua đi lên đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ ngồi xuống tại lối vào Cổng Mới của đền thờ để xét xử vụ việc.

ko.L: 그리고 유다의 고관들이 이 일들을 듣고, 왕의 집에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 올라와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 새 문 어귀에 앉았다.
ko.B: 유다의 관리들이 이 소식을 듣고, 왕궁에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 올라와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 새 문 어귀에 자리를 잡고 앉았다.
ko.R: 유다의 지도자들이 그 일을 들었다. 그래서 그들은 왕궁에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 올라갔다. 그들은 재판을 하려고 성전 새 문 어귀에 앉았다.

decisions.choice: they came up from the king's palace: the palace stood below the temple
decisions.reason: The temple was on the highest part of the hill, north of and above the royal buildings, so one went "up" from the palace to the temple (36:10-12; 2 Kings 11:19 goes "down" the other way).

decisions.choice: they sat at the entrance of the gate: they met as a court to judge the case
decisions.reason: The gate was where elders and officials sat to hear cases and give judgment (Deuteronomy 21:19; Ruth 4:1-2; Amos 5:15). The king's officials take their seats to try Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: the New Gate of the LORD: a gate of the temple courts
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the gate of the LORD, the new one". Some Hebrew manuscripts and the early translations have "the New Gate of the house of the LORD", as 36:10 does. The sense is the same: a gate of the temple, perhaps the upper gate built by Jotham (2 Kings 15:35).

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (1:18). These are the king's chief officers, not his sons.

decisions.choice: the New Gate of the LORD's house (B); the New Gate of the temple (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the gate belonged to the temple, as 36:10 puts it (m3).

decisions.choice: to hear the case
decisions.reason: Readable says why they sat at the gate (m2).

decisions.choice: los príncipes (Literal); los jefes (Balanced); los dirigentes (Readable)
decisions.reason: The *sarim* of Judah keep this wording at each level through the block; Literal says "príncipes" as the English says "princes".

decisions.choice: wakuu (Literal); maafisa (Balanced); viongozi (Readable)
decisions.reason: *Sarim* in these narrative chapters, at each level as the English has princes, officials and leaders.

decisions.choice: "các quan trưởng" (L); "các quan chức" (B); "các nhà lãnh đạo" (R) for the princes (sarim)
decisions.reason: The princes are the king's officials, not his sons. The wording is the one used for sarim throughout Jeremiah (1:18; 36:12; 38:4) and Ezra, with "quan chức" as in 2 Kings 24:12, 14 Balanced.

decisions.choice: "고관들" (L); "관리들" (B); "지도자들" (R) for *sarim*
decisions.reason: As the English settles one word per level for *sar* in these chapters; "방백" is an older church word.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהַנְּבִאִים֙ אֶל־הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־כָּל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּט־מָ֨וֶת֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י נִבָּא֙ אֶל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the priests and the prophets to the princes and to all the people, saying, [A] sentence of death [is] for the man this, for he has prophesied against the city this, as you have heard with your ears.

en.L: And the priests and the prophets said to the princes and to all the people, saying, "A sentence of death [belongs] to this man, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your [own] ears."
en.B: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and to all the people, "This man ought to be condemned to death. He has prophesied against this city; you heard it with your own ears."
en.R: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the leaders and all the people. "This man must be put to death!" they said. "He has prophesied against this city. You heard him yourselves!"

es.L: Y los sacerdotes y los profetas hablaron a los príncipes y a todo el pueblo, diciendo: «Sentencia de muerte [merece] este hombre, porque ha profetizado contra esta ciudad, como {{plural_you:ustedes han|vosotros habéis}} oído con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} [propios] oídos».
es.B: Entonces los sacerdotes y los profetas dijeron a los jefes y a todo el pueblo: «Este hombre merece ser condenado a muerte. Ha profetizado contra esta ciudad; {{plural_you:ustedes lo han|vosotros lo habéis}} oído con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios oídos».
es.R: Entonces los sacerdotes y los profetas hablaron a los dirigentes y a todo el pueblo. «¡Este hombre tiene que morir!», dijeron. «Ha profetizado contra esta ciudad. ¡{{plural_you:Ustedes mismos lo oyeron|Vosotros mismos lo oísteis}}!».

fr.L: Et les prêtres et les prophètes dirent aux princes et à tout le peuple : « Une sentence de mort [revient] à cet homme, car il a prophétisé contre cette ville, comme vous l’avez entendu de vos [propres] oreilles. »
fr.B: Alors les prêtres et les prophètes dirent aux chefs et à tout le peuple : « Cet homme mérite d’être condamné à mort. Il a prophétisé contre cette ville ; vous l’avez entendu de vos propres oreilles. »
fr.R: Alors les prêtres et les prophètes ont parlé aux chefs et à tout le peuple. « Cet homme doit être mis à mort ! ont-ils dit. Il a prophétisé contre cette ville. Vous l’avez entendu vous-mêmes ! »

sw.L: Ndipo makuhani na manabii wakawaambia wakuu na watu wote, wakisema, "Mtu huyu astahili hukumu ya kufa, kwa maana ametabiri juu ya mji huu, kama mlivyosikia kwa masikio yenu."
sw.B: Ndipo makuhani na manabii wakawaambia maafisa na watu wote, "Mtu huyu anastahili kuhukumiwa kifo. Ametabiri dhidi ya mji huu; mmesikia kwa masikio yenu wenyewe."
sw.R: Ndipo makuhani na manabii wakazungumza na viongozi na watu wote. Wakasema, "Mtu huyu lazima auawe! Ametabiri dhidi ya mji huu. Mmemsikia wenyewe!"

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri nói với các quan trưởng và toàn dân rằng: "Người này đáng bị án tử hình, vì nó đã nói tiên tri nghịch cùng thành này như chính tai các ông đã nghe."
vi.B: Bấy giờ các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri nói với các quan chức và toàn dân: "Người này đáng bị kết án tử hình, vì nó đã nói tiên tri nghịch cùng thành này; chính tai các ông đã nghe."
vi.R: Bấy giờ các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri nói với các nhà lãnh đạo và toàn dân: "Người này phải bị xử tử! Nó đã nói tiên tri nghịch cùng thành này. Chính các ông đã nghe nó nói!"

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들과 예언자들이 고관들과 모든 백성에게 말했다. "이 사람에게는 사형 판결이 [마땅합니다]. 여러분이 [직접] 귀로 들은 것처럼, 그가 이 성에 대하여 예언했습니다."
ko.B: 그러자 제사장들과 예언자들이 관리들과 모든 백성에게 말했다. "이 사람은 사형을 받아야 마땅합니다. 여러분이 직접 귀로 들으신 것처럼, 그가 이 성을 거슬러 예언했습니다."
ko.R: 그러자 제사장들과 예언자들이 지도자들과 모든 백성에게 말했다. "이 사람은 사형을 당해야 합니다! 그는 이 성을 거슬러 예언했습니다. 여러분이 직접 들으셨습니다!"

decisions.choice: a sentence of death belongs to this man: he is guilty of a crime that carries the death penalty
decisions.reason: The same words are used in the Law of a person who deserves to die (Deuteronomy 19:6; 21:22). The priests and prophets now bring the charge formally before the court.

decisions.choice: against this city: the charge names the city, not only the temple
decisions.reason: In verse 9 they spoke of the house and the city. Before the king's officials they stress the threat to the city, which made Jeremiah's words sound like treason against the state.

decisions.choice: you have heard: spoken to all those present
decisions.reason: The people had heard Jeremiah themselves (verse 7). The officials may have arrived later, but they are addressed with the crowd as one court.

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (1:18). These are the king's chief officers, not his sons.

decisions.choice: ought to be condemned to death (B); must be put to death (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the legal phrase; verse 16 answers it with the same wording turned around.

decisions.choice: The priests and prophets speak to the officials in 합쇼체 ("마땅합니다")
decisions.reason: They bring a charge before the officials sitting as a court (meaning decision m2 of 26:10), so they speak to them as to superiors.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶל־כָּל־הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־כָּל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֗נִי לְהִנָּבֵ֞א אֶל־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jeremiah to all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahweh sent me to prophesy against the house this and against the city this all the words that you have heard.

en.L: And Jeremiah said to all the princes and to all the people, saying, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
en.B: Then Jeremiah addressed all the officials and all the people: "It was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who sent me to prophesy against this house and this city, to speak all the words you have heard.
en.R: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the leaders and all the people. "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent me," he said. "He told me to prophesy against this temple and this city. He gave me all the words you have heard.

es.L: Y Jeremías habló a todos los príncipes y a todo el pueblo, diciendo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me envió a profetizar contra esta casa y contra esta ciudad todas las palabras que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} oído.
es.B: Entonces Jeremías se dirigió a todos los jefes y a todo el pueblo: «Fue {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien me envió a profetizar contra esta casa y esta ciudad, a decir todas las palabras que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} oído.
es.R: Entonces Jeremías habló a todos los dirigentes y a todo el pueblo. «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me envió», les dijo. «Él me mandó profetizar contra este templo y esta ciudad. Él me dio todas las palabras que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} oído.

fr.L: Et Jérémie dit à tous les princes et à tout le peuple : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé prophétiser contre cette maison et contre cette ville toutes les paroles que vous avez entendues.
fr.B: Alors Jérémie s’adressa à tous les chefs et à tout le peuple : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui m’a envoyé prophétiser contre cette maison et cette ville, pour dire toutes les paroles que vous avez entendues.
fr.R: Alors Jérémie a parlé à tous les chefs et à tout le peuple. « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui m’a envoyé, a-t-il dit. Il m’a dit de prophétiser contre ce temple et cette ville. Il m’a donné toutes les paroles que vous avez entendues.

sw.L: Ndipo Yeremia akawaambia wakuu wote na watu wote, akisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma kutabiri juu ya nyumba hii na juu ya mji huu maneno yote mliyoyasikia.
sw.B: Ndipo Yeremia akawaambia maafisa wote na watu wote: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye aliyenituma kutabiri dhidi ya nyumba hii na mji huu, kusema maneno yote mliyoyasikia.
sw.R: Ndipo Yeremia akazungumza na viongozi wote na watu wote. Akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye aliyenituma. Aliniambia nitabiri dhidi ya hekalu hili na mji huu. Alinipa maneno yote mliyoyasikia.

vi.L: Giê-rê-mi nói với tất cả các quan trưởng và toàn dân rằng: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi nói tiên tri nghịch cùng nhà này và thành này mọi lời mà anh em đã nghe.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giê-rê-mi nói với tất cả các quan chức và toàn dân: "Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi nói tiên tri nghịch cùng nhà này và thành này mọi lời anh em đã nghe.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Giê-rê-mi nói với tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo và toàn dân: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi. Ngài bảo tôi nói tiên tri nghịch cùng đền thờ này và thành này. Ngài đã ban cho tôi mọi lời anh em đã nghe.

ko.L: 그러자 예레미야가 모든 고관과 모든 백성에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분이 들은 이 모든 말을 이 집과 이 성에 대하여 예언하라고 나를 보내셨습니다.
ko.B: 그러자 예레미야가 모든 관리와 모든 백성에게 말했다. "여러분이 들은 그 모든 말을 이 집과 이 성에 대하여 예언하라고 나를 보내신 분은 바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이십니다.
ko.R: 그러자 예레미야가 모든 지도자와 모든 백성에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 보내셨습니다. 그분께서 이 성전과 이 성을 거슬러 예언하라고 하셨습니다. 여러분이 들은 말은 모두 그분께서 주신 말씀입니다.

decisions.choice: The LORD sent me: the LORD's name stands first, for emphasis
decisions.reason: The charge was that he spoke in the LORD's name without being sent (verse 9). Jeremiah answers by putting the LORD first: it was the LORD who sent him.

decisions.choice: against this house and against this city: he names both, as he had
decisions.reason: Jeremiah does not take back any part of his message. He names the temple again, which the priests left out of their charge (verse 11).

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (1:18). These are the king's chief officers, not his sons.

decisions.choice: He told me ...; He gave me all the words
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence in two and repeats the subject. Sentence-initial "He" for God needs no setting span.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah says "anh em" to the court and the crowd
decisions.reason: The terms note: the prophet says "anh em" where he pleads, as here (and in 42), and "các người" in rebuke.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah answers the officials and people in 합쇼체, with "여러분" and "나"
decisions.reason: He defends himself before a court of officials, so he speaks politely; he keeps "나" rather than the humble "저", since he speaks as the LORD's messenger.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֵיטִ֤יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶם֙ וּמַ֣עַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשִׁמְע֕וּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְיִנָּחֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now make good your ways and your deeds and listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God, and will relent Yahweh concerning the disaster that he has spoken against you.

en.L: And now, make good your ways and your deeds, and listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will relent concerning the disaster that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spoken against you.
en.B: So now, change your ways and your actions for the better, and obey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will relent concerning the disaster {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has pronounced against you.
en.R: So now, change the way you live and the things you do. Obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will change {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind about the disaster {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would bring on you.

es.L: Ahora, pues, {{plural_you:mejoren sus caminos y sus obras|mejorad vuestros caminos y vuestras obras}}, y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se retractará del mal que ha hablado contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Así que ahora, {{plural_you:mejoren su manera de vivir y sus acciones|mejorad vuestra manera de vivir y vuestras acciones}}, y {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desistirá del desastre que ha anunciado contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Así que ahora, {{plural_you:cambien su manera de vivir y lo que hacen|cambiad vuestra manera de vivir y lo que hacéis}}. {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cambiará de parecer acerca del desastre que dijo que traería sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, rendez bonnes vos voies et vos actions, et écoutez la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} renoncera au malheur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a annoncé contre vous.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, améliorez votre conduite et vos actions, et obéissez à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} renoncera au malheur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prononcé contre vous.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, changez votre façon de vivre et ce que vous faites. Obéissez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} changera d’avis au sujet du malheur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ferait venir sur vous.

sw.L: Basi sasa, zitengenezeni njia zenu na matendo yenu, mkaisikilize sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataghairi kuhusu maafa aliyoyanena juu yenu.
sw.B: Basi sasa, badilisheni njia zenu na matendo yenu yawe mema, mkaitii sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataghairi kuhusu maafa aliyoyatamka dhidi yenu.
sw.R: Basi sasa, badilisheni jinsi mnavyoishi na mambo mnayoyafanya. Mtiini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atabadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuhusu maafa aliyosema atawaletea.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, hãy làm cho đường lối và việc làm của anh em nên tốt, và hãy nghe tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, thì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng anh em.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, anh em hãy sửa đổi đường lối và việc làm của mình cho tốt đẹp, và vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em. Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã báo trước cho anh em.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, anh em hãy thay đổi cách sống và những việc anh em làm. Hãy vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em. Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán sẽ giáng trên anh em.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 여러분의 길과 행실을 좋게 하고, 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 들으십시오. 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 내리겠다고 말씀하신 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키실 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 여러분의 길과 행실을 바르게 고치고, 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리에 순종하십시오. 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 선언하신 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키실 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러니 이제 여러분이 사는 방식과 하는 일을 바꾸십시오. 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종하십시오. 그러면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 내리겠다고 하신 재앙에 대하여 마음을 바꾸실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: make good your ways and your deeds: the call of the temple sermon
decisions.reason: The same words are in 7:3, 5. Jeremiah's defense is to repeat his message: there is still time to change.

decisions.choice: listen to the voice of the LORD: obey him
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is to do what they say (7:23; Deuteronomy 13:5).

decisions.choice: the LORD will relent: as God said in verse 3
decisions.reason: Jeremiah repeats what God told him: the disaster can still be turned back if the people turn back.

decisions.choice: make good your ways and your deeds (L); change your ways and your actions for the better (B); change the way you live and the things you do (R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:3.

decisions.choice: obey
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m2); Literal keeps "listen to the voice".

decisions.choice: mejoren sus caminos y sus obras (Literal); mejoren su manera de vivir y sus acciones (Balanced); cambien su manera de vivir y lo que hacen (Readable)
decisions.reason: The call of the temple sermon keeps the wording of 18:11 at each level.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֖י הִנְנִ֣י בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם עֲשׂוּ־לִ֛י כַּטּ֥וֹב וְכַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, look, I [am] in your hand; do to me as the good and as the right in your eyes.

en.L: And I, look, I [am] in your hand; do to me as [is] good and as [is] right in your eyes.
en.B: As for me, look, I am in your power. Do to me what seems good and right in your eyes.
en.R: As for me, I am in your power. Do to me whatever you think is good and fair.

es.L: Y yo, he aquí, [estoy] en {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}; {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} conmigo como [sea] bueno y como [sea] recto ante {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}.
es.B: En cuanto a mí, aquí estoy, en {{plural_you:su poder|vuestro poder}}. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} conmigo lo que {{plural_you:les parezca|os parezca}} bueno y justo.
es.R: En cuanto a mí, estoy en {{plural_you:su poder|vuestro poder}}. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} conmigo lo que {{plural_you:les parezca|os parezca}} bueno y justo.

fr.L: Et moi, voici, je [suis] entre vos mains ; faites-moi ce qui [est] bon et ce qui [est] droit à vos yeux.
fr.B: Quant à moi, me voici entre vos mains. Faites de moi ce qui vous semble bon et juste.
fr.R: Quant à moi, je suis en votre pouvoir. Faites de moi ce que vous jugez bon et juste.

sw.L: Na mimi, tazama, [niko] mkononi mwenu; nitendeeni kama [ilivyo] vema na kama [ilivyo] sawa machoni penu.
sw.B: Na mimi, tazama, niko mikononi mwenu. Nitendeeni yale mnayoyaona kuwa mema na ya haki.
sw.R: Kwa upande wangu, niko mikononi mwenu. Nitendeeni lolote mnaloona ni jema na la haki.

vi.L: Còn tôi, kìa, tôi [ở] trong tay anh em; hãy làm cho tôi điều [gì] tốt và [gì] phải theo mắt anh em.
vi.B: Còn tôi, này, tôi ở trong tay anh em. Hãy xử với tôi theo điều anh em thấy là tốt và phải.
vi.R: Còn tôi, tôi ở trong tay anh em. Hãy làm cho tôi bất cứ điều gì anh em cho là tốt và công bằng.

ko.L: 그리고 나는, 보십시오, 여러분의 손에 [있습니다]. 여러분의 눈에 좋고 옳은 대로 나에게 하십시오.
ko.B: 나로 말하면, 보십시오, 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다. 여러분이 보기에 좋고 옳은 대로 나를 처리하십시오.
ko.R: 나는 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다. 여러분이 좋고 옳다고 생각하는 대로 나에게 하십시오.

decisions.choice: in your hand: in your power, for you to decide what happens to me
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control (38:5; Genesis 16:6). Jeremiah does not resist the court.

decisions.choice: as is good and as is right in your eyes: as you judge best
decisions.reason: Jeremiah leaves the decision to them, but by speaking of what is good and right he reminds the judges that they must act justly.

decisions.choice: in your power
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "in your hand" (m1).

source.text: אַ֣ךְ׀יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אִם־מְמִתִ֣ים אַתֶּם֮ אֹתִי֒ כִּי־דָ֣ם נָקִ֗י אַתֶּם֙ נֹתְנִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י בֶאֱמֶ֗ת שְׁלָחַ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּר֙ בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Only knowing know that if putting to death you [are] me, that blood innocent you [are] putting on yourselves and on the city this and on its inhabitants, for in truth has sent me Yahweh to you to speak in your ears all the words these.

en.L: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you [will be] putting innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on its inhabitants, for in truth {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has sent me to you to speak in your ears all these words."
en.B: But know this for certain: if you put me to death, you will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves, on this city and on the people who live in it, for it is true that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent me to you to speak all these words for you to hear."
en.R: But you can be sure of this: If you kill me, you will be guilty of killing an innocent man. The guilt will fall on you, on this city and on everyone who lives in it. It is true! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} really did send me to you to tell you all these things."

es.L: Solo {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} con certeza que si {{plural_you:ustedes me matan|vosotros me matáis}}, {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} sangre inocente sobre {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}, y sobre esta ciudad y sobre sus habitantes, porque en verdad {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha enviado a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para hablar en {{plural_you:sus oídos|vuestros oídos}} todas estas palabras».
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} esto con certeza: si me {{plural_you:matan|matáis}}, {{plural_you:traerán|traeréis}} la culpa de sangre inocente sobre {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}, sobre esta ciudad y sobre los que viven en ella, porque es verdad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me envió a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:decirles|deciros}} todas estas palabras».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} estar seguros de esto: si me {{plural_you:matan|matáis}}, {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} culpables de matar a un hombre inocente. La culpa caerá sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sobre esta ciudad y sobre todos los que viven en ella. ¡Es la verdad! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de verdad me envió a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:decirles|deciros}} todas estas cosas».

fr.L: Seulement, sachez bien que si vous me faites mourir, vous mettez un sang innocent sur vous, et sur cette ville, et sur ses habitants, car en vérité {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé vers vous pour dire à vos oreilles toutes ces paroles. »
fr.B: Mais sachez-le bien : si vous me faites mourir, vous ferez retomber la faute d’un sang innocent sur vous-mêmes, sur cette ville et sur ses habitants, car c’est vraiment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui m’a envoyé vers vous pour vous faire entendre toutes ces paroles. »
fr.R: Mais soyez-en sûrs : si vous me tuez, vous serez coupables d’avoir tué un innocent. La faute retombera sur vous, sur cette ville et sur tous ses habitants. C’est la vérité ! C’est vraiment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui m’a envoyé vers vous pour vous dire toutes ces choses. »

sw.L: Ila jueni hakika kwamba mkiniua, mtajitwika damu isiyo na hatia juu yenu wenyewe na juu ya mji huu na juu ya wakazi wake, kwa maana kweli {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenituma kwenu kunena masikioni mwenu maneno haya yote."
sw.B: Lakini jueni hakika: mkiniua, mtajiletea hatia ya damu isiyo na hatia juu yenu wenyewe, juu ya mji huu na juu ya watu wanaoishi ndani yake, kwa maana ni kweli kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma kwenu kusema maneno haya yote mkayasikie."
sw.R: Lakini mwe na hakika juu ya jambo hili: Mkiniua, mtakuwa na hatia ya kumuua mtu asiye na hatia. Hatia hiyo itawaangukia ninyi, mji huu na kila mtu anayeishi ndani yake. Ni kweli! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kweli alinituma kwenu kuwaambia mambo haya yote."

vi.L: Chỉ có điều, hãy biết chắc rằng nếu anh em giết tôi, anh em [sẽ] đổ máu vô tội trên chính mình, trên thành này và trên cư dân của nó, vì thật {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi đến với anh em để nói vào tai anh em mọi lời này."
vi.B: Nhưng anh em hãy biết chắc điều này: nếu anh em giết tôi, anh em sẽ mang tội đổ máu vô tội trên chính mình, trên thành này và trên dân cư thành này, vì thật {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi đến để nói cho anh em nghe mọi lời này."
vi.R: Nhưng anh em hãy biết chắc điều này: Nếu anh em giết tôi, anh em sẽ mắc tội giết một người vô tội. Tội ấy sẽ đổ trên anh em, trên thành này và trên mọi người sống trong thành. Đó là sự thật! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thật sự sai tôi đến để nói với anh em mọi điều này."

ko.L: 다만 분명히 알아 두십시오. 여러분이 나를 죽이면, 여러분은 죄 없는 피를 여러분 자신과 이 성과 그 주민들에게 돌리는 것입니다. 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 모든 말을 여러분의 귀에 전하라고 나를 여러분에게 보내셨기 때문입니다."
ko.B: 그러나 이것만은 분명히 알아 두십시오. 여러분이 나를 죽이면, 죄 없는 사람의 피를 흘린 죄가 여러분과 이 성과 이 성 주민들에게 돌아갈 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 모든 말을 여러분에게 들려주라고 참으로 나를 보내셨기 때문입니다."
ko.R: 그러나 이것은 확실히 알아 두십시오. 여러분이 나를 죽이면, 죄 없는 사람을 죽인 죄를 짓게 됩니다. 그 죄가 여러분과 이 성과 이 성에 사는 모든 사람에게 돌아갈 것입니다. 이것은 사실입니다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 정말로 나를 여러분에게 보내셔서 이 모든 말을 전하게 하셨습니다."

decisions.choice: know for certain: the doubled verb makes it a solemn warning
decisions.reason: The verb "know" is repeated, "knowing you will know", to stress that they must not be mistaken about what they are doing.

decisions.choice: putting innocent blood on yourselves: taking on the guilt of killing an innocent person
decisions.reason: The blood of someone wrongly killed was thought of as resting on those responsible, and on the whole community, until God dealt with it (Deuteronomy 19:10; 21:8-9). Jeremiah's preaching named this very sin (7:6).

decisions.choice: in truth: it is really so
decisions.reason: Jeremiah answers the charge of verse 9. He is not a false prophet; the LORD truly sent him.

decisions.choice: to speak in your ears: to speak to you directly, so that you hear
decisions.reason: The phrase stresses that they themselves have heard the message (verse 11).

decisions.choice: the guilt of innocent blood (B); guilty of killing an innocent man (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture of blood on someone means (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְכָל־הָעָ֔ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאֶל־הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים אֵין־לָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ מִשְׁפַּט־מָ֔וֶת כִּ֗י בְּשֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the princes and all the people to the priests and to the prophets, There is not for the man this [a] sentence of death, for in [the] name of Yahweh our God he has spoken to us.

en.L: And the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, "There is no sentence of death for this man, for he has spoken to us in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God."
en.B: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man ought not to be condemned to death, for it is in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God that he has spoken to us."
en.R: Then the leaders and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man must not be put to death! He has spoken to us with the authority of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God."

es.L: Y los príncipes y todo el pueblo dijeron a los sacerdotes y a los profetas: «No hay sentencia de muerte para este hombre, porque nos ha hablado en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».
es.B: Entonces los jefes y todo el pueblo dijeron a los sacerdotes y a los profetas: «Este hombre no merece ser condenado a muerte, porque nos ha hablado en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».
es.R: Entonces los dirigentes y todo el pueblo dijeron a los sacerdotes y a los profetas: «¡Este hombre no debe morir! Nos ha hablado con la autoridad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».

fr.L: Et les princes et tout le peuple dirent aux prêtres et aux prophètes : « Il n’y a pas pour cet homme de sentence de mort, car il nous a parlé au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu. »
fr.B: Alors les chefs et tout le peuple dirent aux prêtres et aux prophètes : « Cet homme ne mérite pas d’être condamné à mort, car c’est au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu qu’il nous a parlé. »
fr.R: Alors les chefs et tout le peuple ont dit aux prêtres et aux prophètes : « Cet homme ne doit pas être mis à mort ! Il nous a parlé avec l’autorité {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu. »

sw.L: Ndipo wakuu na watu wote wakawaambia makuhani na manabii, "Mtu huyu hastahili hukumu ya kufa, kwa maana amesema nasi kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu."
sw.B: Ndipo maafisa na watu wote wakawaambia makuhani na manabii, "Mtu huyu hastahili kuhukumiwa kifo, kwa maana amesema nasi kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu."
sw.R: Ndipo viongozi na watu wote wakawaambia makuhani na manabii, "Mtu huyu hapaswi kuuawa! Amesema nasi kwa mamlaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu."

vi.L: Các quan trưởng và toàn dân nói với các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri: "Người này không đáng bị án tử hình, vì người đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta mà nói với chúng ta."
vi.B: Bấy giờ các quan chức và toàn dân nói với các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri: "Người này không đáng bị kết án tử hình, vì người đã nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta mà nói với chúng ta."
vi.R: Bấy giờ các nhà lãnh đạo và toàn dân nói với các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri: "Không được xử tử người này! Người đã nói với chúng ta bằng thẩm quyền của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta."

ko.L: 그러자 고관들과 모든 백성이 제사장들과 예언자들에게 말했다. "이 사람에게는 사형 판결이 [마땅하지] 않다. 그가 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 우리에게 말했기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러자 관리들과 모든 백성이 제사장들과 예언자들에게 말했다. "이 사람은 사형을 받을 까닭이 없다. 그는 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 우리에게 말했다."
ko.R: 그러자 지도자들과 모든 백성이 제사장들과 예언자들에게 말했다. "이 사람을 죽여서는 안 된다! 그는 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 권위를 가지고 우리에게 말했다."

decisions.choice: the officials and all the people against the priests and the prophets: the crowd changes sides
decisions.reason: In verse 8 all the people joined the priests and prophets in seizing Jeremiah. Now they stand with the officials, and the priests and prophets are left alone in their charge.

decisions.choice: he has spoken in the name of the LORD our God: they accept that he may truly be the LORD's messenger
decisions.reason: The court turns the charge of verse 9 around. A prophet who speaks in the LORD's name must be heard (Deuteronomy 18:19), and they will not put him to death for it.

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (1:18). These are the king's chief officers, not his sons.

decisions.choice: ought not to be condemned to death (B); must not be put to death (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict answers the charge of verse 11 in the same words.

decisions.choice: with the authority of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says what speaking "in the name of" the LORD means.

decisions.choice: The officials answer the priests and prophets in the plain style ("않다")
decisions.reason: The officials sit as judges and give their verdict; they speak down to the accusers, not up.
