ko.B: 그때 그 땅의 장로들 가운데 몇 사람이 일어나 모여 있는 온 백성에게 말했다.
ko.R: 그때 유다 성읍들에서 온 장로들 가운데 몇 사람이 일어나 그곳에 모여 있는 모든 백성에게 말했다.

decisions.choice: the elders of the land: leaders of the families and towns of Judah
decisions.reason: Elders were the senior men who led their clans and towns and judged local cases (Deuteronomy 19:12; Ruth 4:2). They were not royal officers like the officials of verse 10, and they knew the history of the land.

decisions.choice: they arose: they stood up to speak before the court
decisions.reason: Standing up was the way to speak at an assembly or a trial (Deuteronomy 19:16; Micah 6:1).

decisions.choice: the assembly of the people: the whole crowd gathered at the gate
decisions.reason: The word means a gathering called together, here the people present at the hearing.

decisions.choice: from the towns of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the land" means here: the country around Jerusalem.

source.text: מִיכָה֙ הַמּ֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י הָיָ֣ה נִבָּ֔א בִּימֵ֖י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־כָּל־עַם֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה לֵאמֹ֜ר כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר׀יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵֽחָרֵשׁ֙ וִירוּשָׁלַ֨יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: Micah the Morashtite was prophesying in [the] days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he said to all [the] people of Judah, saying, Thus says Yahweh of hosts: Zion [as a] field will be plowed, and Jerusalem heaps of ruins will become, and [the] mountain of the house for high places of [a] forest.

en.L: "Micah the Morashtite was prophesying in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he said to all the people of Judah, saying, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: \q Zion will be plowed [as] a field, \q and Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, \q and the mountain of the house [will become] high places of a forest.'
en.B: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He said to all the people of Judah, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: \q Zion will be plowed as a field, \q Jerusalem will be a mound of ruins, \q and the mountain of the temple a wooded height.'
en.R: "Micah from the town of Moresheth was a prophet when Hezekiah was king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q Zion will be plowed up like a field. \q Jerusalem will become a pile of ruins. \q The hill where the temple stands will be covered with trees and bushes.'

es.L: «Miqueas el morastita profetizaba en los días de Ezequías, rey de Judá, y habló a todo el pueblo de Judá, diciendo: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: \q Sion será arada [como] un campo, \q y Jerusalén se convertirá en montones de ruinas, \q y el monte de la casa [en] alturas de bosque”.
es.B: «Miqueas de Moréset profetizó en los días de Ezequías, rey de Judá. Le dijo a todo el pueblo de Judá: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: \q Sion será arada como un campo, \q Jerusalén será un montón de ruinas, \q y el monte del templo, una colina cubierta de bosque”.
es.R: «Miqueas, del pueblo de Moréset, era profeta cuando Ezequías era rey de Judá. Le dijo a todo el pueblo de Judá: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: \q Sion será arada como un campo. \q Jerusalén se convertirá en un montón de ruinas. \q La colina donde está el templo se cubrirá de árboles y matorrales”.

fr.L: « Michée le Morashtite prophétisait aux jours d’Ézéchias, roi de Juda, et il dit à tout le peuple de Juda : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Sion sera labourée [comme] un champ, \q et Jérusalem deviendra des monceaux de ruines, \q et la montagne de la maison, des hauteurs boisées.”
fr.B: « Michée de Morèsheth prophétisait au temps d’Ézéchias, roi de Juda. Il a dit à tout le peuple de Juda : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : \q Sion sera labourée comme un champ, \q Jérusalem sera un tas de ruines, \q et la montagne du temple une hauteur couverte de bois.”
fr.R: « Michée, de la ville de Morèsheth, était prophète quand Ézéchias était roi de Juda. Il a dit à tout le peuple de Juda : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Sion sera labourée comme un champ. \q Jérusalem deviendra un tas de ruines. \q La colline où se trouve le temple sera couverte d’arbres et de broussailles.”

sw.L: "Mika Mmoreshethi alikuwa akitabiri katika siku za Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda, naye akawaambia watu wote wa Yuda, akisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: \q Sayuni utalimwa [kama] shamba, \q na Yerusalemu utakuwa magofu, \q na mlima wa nyumba [utakuwa] mahali pa juu pa msitu.'
sw.B: "Mika wa Moreshethi alitabiri katika siku za Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda. Aliwaambia watu wote wa Yuda, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: \q Sayuni utalimwa kama shamba, \q Yerusalemu utakuwa rundo la magofu, \q na mlima wa hekalu utakuwa kilima cha msitu.'
sw.R: "Mika kutoka mji wa Moreshethi alikuwa nabii wakati Hezekia alipokuwa mfalme wa Yuda. Aliwaambia watu wote wa Yuda, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: \q Sayuni utalimwa kama shamba. \q Yerusalemu utakuwa rundo la magofu. \q Kilima ambapo hekalu limesimama kitafunikwa na miti na vichaka.'

vi.L: "Mi-chê người Mô-rê-sết đã nói tiên tri trong đời Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa, và ông đã nói với toàn dân Giu-đa rằng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: \q Si-ôn sẽ bị cày [như] một cánh đồng, \q Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ thành những đống đổ nát, \q và núi của nhà [sẽ thành] những gò cao trong rừng.'
vi.B: "Mi-chê người Mô-rê-sết đã nói tiên tri trong đời Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa. Ông nói với toàn dân Giu-đa: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: \q Si-ôn sẽ bị cày như cánh đồng, \q Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ thành một gò đổ nát, \q và núi đền thờ sẽ thành một đồi cây rậm rạp.'
vi.R: "Mi-chê, người thành Mô-rê-sết, là một nhà tiên tri vào thời Ê-xê-chia làm vua Giu-đa. Ông nói với toàn dân Giu-đa: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q Si-ôn sẽ bị cày lên như một cánh đồng. \q Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ thành một đống đổ nát. \q Ngọn đồi nơi đền thờ đứng sẽ bị cây cối và bụi rậm phủ kín.'

ko.L: "모레셋 사람 미가가 유다 왕 히스기야의 시대에 예언하며 유다의 모든 백성에게 말했습니다. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 시온은 밭처럼 갈아엎어지고, \q 예루살렘은 돌무더기가 되며, \q 성전이 [서 있는] 산은 숲속의 산당처럼 될 것이다.'
ko.B: "모레셋 사람 미가가 유다 왕 히스기야가 다스리던 때에 예언했습니다. 그가 유다의 모든 백성에게 말했습니다. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 시온은 밭처럼 갈아엎어지고, \q 예루살렘은 폐허 더미가 되며, \q 성전이 선 산은 숲이 우거진 언덕이 될 것이다.'
ko.R: "모레셋 마을 출신의 미가는 히스기야가 유다의 왕이었을 때에 예언자였습니다. 그는 유다의 모든 백성에게 말했습니다. '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 시온은 밭처럼 갈아엎어질 것이다. \q 예루살렘은 돌무더기가 될 것이다. \q 성전이 서 있는 언덕은 나무와 덤불로 뒤덮일 것이다.'

decisions.choice: the elders quote Micah 3:12
decisions.reason: The words from "Zion" on are Micah 3:12 almost word for word. In Micah the saying begins "Therefore, because of you", and the elders put "Thus says the LORD of hosts" before it; Micah also has a different spelling of the word for "heaps of ruins". Micah has not yet been translated in this project; when it is, the two passages should be compared.

decisions.choice: Micah the Morashtite: Micah from Moresheth, a town in the hill country southwest of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Micah 1:1 calls him the Morashtite, and Micah 1:14 names Moresheth-gath. He prophesied about a hundred years before Jeremiah, in the time of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah (Micah 1:1).

decisions.choice: Micah: the margin's reading of the name is followed
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has the longer form of the name, Micaiah; the scribes noted the shorter form Micah in the margin to be read aloud, as in Micah 1:1. It is the same man.

decisions.choice: the mountain of the house will be high places of a forest: the temple hill will be left to grow wild
decisions.reason: "The mountain of the house" is the hill on which the temple stood (Isaiah 2:2). "High places" here means heights or ridges, not shrines: the hill will be overgrown like wild country. Like Shiloh (verse 6), the place of the LORD's house can be left in ruins.

decisions.choice: Micah's saying is set in lines as poetry
decisions.reason: Micah 3:12 is a verse of poetry with three parallel lines: Zion, Jerusalem and the temple hill. The elders' own words are prose.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (L); the LORD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah (Isaiah 1:9) and through Jeremiah (7:3).

decisions.choice: of Moresheth (B); from the town of Moresheth (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name his home town rather than use the word formed from it.

decisions.choice: the mountain of the temple (B); The hill where the temple stands (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say which house is meant (m4).

decisions.choice: Miqueas el morastita (Literal); Miqueas de Moréset (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The elders quote Micah 3:12, not yet drafted in Spanish (meaning decision m1); Micah's town is named as the English names it at each level.

decisions.choice: Mika Mmoreshethi (Literal); Mika wa Moreshethi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The elders quote Micah 3:12, not yet drafted in Swahili; the name follows the published "Mika" of Chronicles, and Micah's book should reuse these lines.

decisions.choice: "Michée le Morashtite" (L); "Michée de Morèsheth" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The prophet's usual French name, "Michée"; Balanced and Readable name his home town, as the English does. Micah 3:12 is not yet translated in French, so this verse sets its wording.

decisions.choice: "Mi-chê người Mô-rê-sết"
decisions.reason: The prophet takes the form of his book's title ("Mi-chê"); 1 Chronicles' "Mi-ca" is other men. Micah 3:12 is not yet drafted in Vietnamese, so this wording will be the one to reuse there.

decisions.choice: "모레셋 사람 미가"
decisions.reason: Micah from Moresheth (meaning decision m2); Korean names him by his town, and the dated-heading formula of the terms note gives "히스기야의 시대에" (L), "다스리던 때에" (B), "왕이었을 때에" (R). The elders speak to the assembly in 합쇼체.

decisions.choice: Micah 3:12 set in lines, worded afresh
decisions.reason: Micah is not yet translated into Korean in this project, so the quotation (meaning decision m1) is drafted here from the Hebrew; Micah should reuse it.

source.text: הֶהָמֵ֣ת הֱ֠מִתֻהוּ חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֜ה וְכָל־יְהוּדָ֗ה הֲלֹא֮ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהוָה֒ וַיְחַל֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים רָעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Putting to death did they put him to death, Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah? Not [was he] fearing Yahweh and entreated [the] face of Yahweh, and relented Yahweh concerning the disaster that he had spoken against them? And we [are] doing [an] evil great against our lives.

en.L: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah indeed put him to death? Did he not fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and entreat the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} relented concerning the disaster that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken against them? But we are doing great evil against our own lives."
en.B: Did Hezekiah king of Judah, or all Judah with him, put him to death? Did Hezekiah not fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and plead for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s favor, so that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} relented concerning the disaster {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had pronounced against them? We are about to bring a great disaster on ourselves!"
en.R: Did King Hezekiah or anyone else in Judah put Micah to death? No! Hezekiah respected {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and begged {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be kind to them. So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} changed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind and did not bring the disaster {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had said {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would bring on them. But we are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!"

es.L: ¿Acaso lo mataron Ezequías, rey de Judá, y todo Judá? ¿No temió él {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y suplicó el favor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se retractó del mal que había hablado contra ellos? Pero nosotros estamos haciendo un gran mal contra nuestras propias vidas».
es.B: ¿Acaso Ezequías, rey de Judá, o todo Judá con él, lo mataron? ¿No temió Ezequías {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y suplicó el favor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de modo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desistió del desastre que había anunciado contra ellos? ¡Estamos a punto de traer una gran desgracia sobre nosotros mismos!».
es.R: ¿Acaso el rey Ezequías o alguien más en Judá mató a Miqueas? ¡No! Ezequías respetó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rogó que fuera bondadoso con ellos. Así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cambió de parecer y no trajo el desastre que había dicho que traería sobre ellos. ¡Pero nosotros estamos a punto de traer una desgracia terrible sobre nosotros mismos!».

fr.L: Ézéchias, roi de Juda, et tout Juda l’ont-ils vraiment fait mourir ? N’a-t-il pas craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et imploré la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a renoncé au malheur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait annoncé contre eux ? Mais nous, nous faisons un grand mal contre nos propres vies. »
fr.B: Ézéchias, roi de Juda, ou tout Juda avec lui, l’ont-ils fait mourir ? Ézéchias n’a-t-il pas craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et imploré la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, si bien que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a renoncé au malheur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prononcé contre eux ? Et nous, nous allons attirer sur nous-mêmes un grand malheur ! »
fr.R: Est-ce que le roi Ézéchias ou quelqu’un d’autre en Juda a fait mourir Michée ? Non ! Ézéchias a respecté {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a supplié d’être bon pour eux. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a changé d’avis et n’a pas fait venir le malheur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait annoncé contre eux. Mais nous, nous allons attirer sur nous un terrible malheur ! »

sw.L: Je, Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda na Yuda wote walimwua kweli? Je, hakumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuomba uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaghairi kuhusu maafa aliyoyanena juu yao? Lakini sisi tunatenda uovu mkubwa juu ya nafsi zetu wenyewe."
sw.B: Je, Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda, au Yuda wote pamoja naye, walimwua? Je, Hezekia hakumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amwonee huruma, hata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaghairi kuhusu maafa aliyoyatamka dhidi yao? Sisi tunakaribia kujiletea maafa makubwa!"
sw.R: Je, Mfalme Hezekia au mtu mwingine yeyote wa Yuda alimwua Mika? Hapana! Hezekia alimheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumsihi awahurumie. Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akabadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, wala hakuleta maafa aliyokuwa amesema atawaletea. Lakini sisi tunakaribia kujiletea maafa makubwa!"

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa và cả Giu-đa có giết ông ấy không? Chẳng phải vua đã kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nài xin ơn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng họ sao? Còn chúng ta đang làm một điều ác lớn nghịch cùng chính mạng sống mình."
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa hay cả Giu-đa có giết ông ấy không? Chẳng phải Ê-xê-chia đã kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nài xin ơn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đổi ý về tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã báo trước cho họ sao? Chúng ta sắp chuốc lấy một tai họa lớn cho chính mình!"
vi.R: Vua Ê-xê-chia hay bất cứ ai trong Giu-đa có giết Mi-chê không? Không! Ê-xê-chia kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót họ. Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đổi ý và không giáng tai họa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán sẽ giáng trên họ. Còn chúng ta sắp chuốc lấy một tai họa khủng khiếp cho chính mình!"

ko.L: 유다 왕 히스기야와 온 유다가 그를 정말 죽였습니까? 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴을 구하자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 내리겠다고 말씀하신 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키지 않으셨습니까? 그런데 우리는 우리 목숨을 해치는 큰 악을 행하고 있습니다."
ko.B: 유다 왕 히스기야나 온 유다가 그를 죽였습니까? 오히려 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 은혜를 간구하지 않았습니까? 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 선언하신 재앙에 대하여 뜻을 돌이키지 않으셨습니까? 그런데 우리는 지금 스스로 큰 재앙을 불러들이려 하고 있습니다!"
ko.R: 히스기야 왕이나 유다의 다른 누가 미가를 죽였습니까? 아닙니다! 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 공경하며 은혜를 베풀어 달라고 간구했습니다. 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 마음을 바꾸시고, 그들에게 내리겠다고 하신 재앙을 내리지 않으셨습니다. 그런데 우리는 지금 스스로 끔찍한 재앙을 불러들이려 하고 있습니다!"

decisions.choice: did they indeed put him to death?: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. The elders' point is that Micah spoke words just as hard as Jeremiah's, and the king did not kill him.

decisions.choice: entreat the face of the LORD: plead with the LORD for his favor
decisions.reason: The phrase is literally to soften or soothe someone's face, to seek their kindness (Exodus 32:11; 1 Kings 13:6). Hezekiah turned to the LORD in prayer, as 2 Kings 19:14-19 and Isaiah 37:14-20 tell of a later crisis.

decisions.choice: the LORD relented: Micah's warning was not carried out in Hezekiah's day
decisions.reason: The elders take the fact that Jerusalem still stood as proof that God had answered Hezekiah's repentance, just as verse 3 says he would answer the people's (see 2 Chronicles 32:26). It does not mean that Micah's word was false.

decisions.choice: great evil against our lives: a great disaster on ourselves
decisions.reason: The word is the same as "disaster" earlier in the verse and in verses 3 and 13. To kill a true prophet would be a great wrong, and it would bring disaster on themselves. "Our lives" means "ourselves".

decisions.choice: the elders' speech ends here
decisions.reason: It began in verse 18.

decisions.choice: plead for the LORD's favor (B); begged him to be kind to them (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m2).

decisions.choice: No! Hezekiah respected the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable answers the first question, as the elders mean it, and turns the second question into a statement. "Respected" gives the sense of fearing the LORD here: honoring him and doing what he says.

decisions.choice: the elders' speech in the passé composé
decisions.reason: A story told inside a speech keeps the tenses of speech in French, as the style guide sets for the speeches of Acts.

source.text: וְגַם־אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֤ה מִתְנַבֵּא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֽוּרִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־שְׁמַעְיָ֔הוּ מִקִּרְיַ֖ת הַיְּעָרִ֑ים וַיִּנָּבֵ֞א עַל־הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את כְּכֹ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And also a man was prophesying in [the] name of Yahweh, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied against the city this and against the land this according to all [the] words of Jeremiah.

en.L: And also a man was prophesying in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
en.B: Another man, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim, was also prophesying in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Against this city and this land he prophesied words just like Jeremiah's.
en.R: There was another man who prophesied in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s name. His name was Uriah son of Shemaiah, and he came from the town of Kiriath-jearim. He gave the same kind of message against this city and this land that Jeremiah gave.

es.L: Y también hubo un hombre que profetizaba en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Urías hijo de Semaías, de Quiriat-jearim, y profetizó contra esta ciudad y contra esta tierra conforme a todas las palabras de Jeremías.
es.B: Otro hombre, Urías hijo de Semaías, de Quiriat-jearim, también profetizaba en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Contra esta ciudad y esta tierra profetizó palabras iguales a las de Jeremías.
es.R: Hubo otro hombre que profetizaba en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Se llamaba Urías hijo de Semaías, y era del pueblo de Quiriat-jearim. Dio contra esta ciudad y esta tierra el mismo tipo de mensaje que daba Jeremías.

fr.L: Et il y avait aussi un homme qui prophétisait au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, Urie fils de Shemaya, de Qiryath-Yearim, et il prophétisa contre cette ville et contre ce pays selon toutes les paroles de Jérémie.
fr.B: Un autre homme, Urie fils de Shemaya, de Qiryath-Yearim, prophétisait lui aussi au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il prophétisa contre cette ville et ce pays des paroles toutes semblables à celles de Jérémie.
fr.R: Il y avait un autre homme qui prophétisait au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il s’appelait Urie, fils de Shemaya, et il venait de la ville de Qiryath-Yearim. Il a donné contre cette ville et ce pays le même genre de message que Jérémie.

sw.L: Tena palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa akitabiri kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Uria mwana wa Shemaya wa Kiriath-yearimu, naye akatabiri juu ya mji huu na juu ya nchi hii sawasawa na maneno yote ya Yeremia.
sw.B: Mtu mwingine, Uria mwana wa Shemaya wa Kiriath-yearimu, naye alikuwa akitabiri kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alitabiri dhidi ya mji huu na nchi hii maneno kama yale ya Yeremia.
sw.R: Kulikuwa na mtu mwingine aliyetabiri kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Jina lake lilikuwa Uria mwana wa Shemaya, naye alitoka mji wa Kiriath-yearimu. Alitoa ujumbe wa namna ileile dhidi ya mji huu na nchi hii kama ule wa Yeremia.

vi.L: Cũng có một người nói tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là U-ri con trai Sê-ma-gia, người Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim; người đã nói tiên tri nghịch cùng thành này và xứ này đúng như mọi lời của Giê-rê-mi.
vi.B: Còn có một người khác cũng nói tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là U-ri con trai Sê-ma-gia, người Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim. Người đã nói tiên tri nghịch cùng thành này và xứ này những lời giống hệt như lời của Giê-rê-mi.
vi.R: Có một người khác cũng nói tiên tri nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tên người là U-ri con trai Sê-ma-gia, quê ở thành Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim. Người đã nói nghịch cùng thành này và xứ này giống như Giê-rê-mi đã nói.

ko.L: 그리고 또 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 예언하는 사람이 있었는데, 기럇여아림 출신 스마야의 아들 우리야였다. 그는 예레미야의 모든 말과 똑같이 이 성과 이 땅에 대하여 예언했다.
ko.B: 기럇여아림 출신 스마야의 아들 우리야라는 사람도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 예언하고 있었다. 그도 이 성과 이 땅에 대하여 예레미야와 똑같은 말로 예언했다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 예언하는 사람이 또 있었다. 그의 이름은 스마야의 아들 우리야였는데, 기럇여아림 마을 출신이었다. 그는 이 성과 이 땅을 거슬러 예레미야와 같은 말씀을 전했다.

decisions.choice: and also a man was prophesying: the narrator adds a second case, which ended differently
alternatives: the speech of Jeremiah's opponents at the trial
decisions.reason: The elders' speech has ended (verse 19), and the narrator now tells what happened to another prophet with the same message. Some read these verses as words spoken at the trial by those who wanted Jeremiah dead, giving a case where a king did put a prophet to death, but nothing in the text marks a new speaker.

decisions.choice: Kiriath-jearim: a town about eight miles west of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: It was the town where the ark stayed for many years before David brought it to Jerusalem (1 Samuel 7:1-2; 2 Samuel 6:2).

decisions.choice: according to all the words of Jeremiah: with the same message as Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Uriah also warned that the city and the land would be destroyed.

decisions.choice: the town of
decisions.reason: Readable says that Kiriath-jearim is a town.

decisions.choice: "Urie fils de Shemaya, de Qiryath-Yearim"
decisions.reason: The French forms of these names as Chronicles gives them (Urie, Shemaya, Qiryath-Yearim).

decisions.choice: "U-ri con trai Sê-ma-gia, người Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim"
decisions.reason: The published forms of these names (1 Chronicles 11:41; 13:5; 15:8).

decisions.choice: "기럇여아림"; "스마야의 아들 우리야"
decisions.reason: Published Korean forms (1 Samuel 7:1; 1 Chronicles 13:5).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־יְ֠הוֹיָקִים וְכָל־גִּבּוֹרָ֤יו וְכָל־הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־דְּבָרָ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֥שׁ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הֲמִית֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אוּרִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וַיִּרָ֔א וַיִּבְרַ֖ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard the king Jehoiakim and all his mighty men and all the princes his words, and sought the king to put him to death; and heard Uriah and was afraid and fled and went [to] Egypt.

en.L: And King Jehoiakim and all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death; and Uriah heard [it], and he was afraid and fled and went [to] Egypt.
en.B: When King Jehoiakim and all his warriors and all the officials heard what he said, the king tried to have him put to death. But Uriah heard of it, and he was afraid and fled to Egypt.
en.R: King Jehoiakim, all his soldiers and all the leaders heard what Uriah said. So the king tried to have him killed. But Uriah found out about it. He was afraid, so he ran away to Egypt.

es.L: Y el rey Joacim, y todos sus valientes, y todos los príncipes oyeron sus palabras, y el rey procuró matarlo; y Urías [lo] oyó, y tuvo miedo, y huyó y se fue [a] Egipto.
es.B: Cuando el rey Joacim y todos sus guerreros y todos los jefes oyeron lo que decía, el rey intentó hacerlo matar. Pero Urías se enteró, tuvo miedo y huyó a Egipto.
es.R: El rey Joacim, todos sus soldados y todos los dirigentes oyeron lo que Urías decía. Entonces el rey trató de hacerlo matar. Pero Urías se enteró. Tuvo miedo, y huyó a Egipto.

fr.L: Et le roi Joïaqim, et tous ses vaillants hommes, et tous les princes entendirent ses paroles, et le roi chercha à le faire mourir ; et Urie [l’]apprit, et il eut peur, et il s’enfuit et alla [en] Égypte.
fr.B: Quand le roi Joïaqim, tous ses guerriers et tous les chefs entendirent ses paroles, le roi chercha à le faire mettre à mort. Mais Urie l’apprit ; il eut peur et s’enfuit en Égypte.
fr.R: Le roi Joïaqim, tous ses soldats et tous les chefs ont entendu ce qu’Urie disait. Alors le roi a cherché à le faire tuer. Mais Urie l’a appris. Il a eu peur, et il s’est enfui en Égypte.

sw.L: Na mfalme Yehoyakimu na mashujaa wake wote na wakuu wote wakayasikia maneno yake, naye mfalme akataka kumwua; na Uria aliposikia, akaogopa, akakimbia, akaenda [mpaka] Misri.
sw.B: Mfalme Yehoyakimu, mashujaa wake wote na maafisa wote waliposikia maneno yake, mfalme alitaka kumwua. Lakini Uria alisikia habari hiyo, akaogopa, akakimbilia Misri.
sw.R: Mfalme Yehoyakimu, askari wake wote na viongozi wote walisikia yale Uria aliyosema. Basi mfalme akataka kumwua. Lakini Uria aligundua jambo hilo. Akaogopa, akakimbilia Misri.

vi.L: Vua Giê-hô-gia-kim, mọi dũng sĩ và mọi quan trưởng của vua nghe những lời của người, thì vua tìm cách giết người; U-ri nghe [vậy], thì sợ hãi, trốn chạy và đi [sang] Ai Cập.
vi.B: Khi vua Giê-hô-gia-kim, mọi chiến sĩ và mọi quan chức của vua nghe những điều người nói, thì vua tìm cách giết người. Nhưng U-ri nghe biết, sợ hãi và trốn sang Ai Cập.
vi.R: Vua Giê-hô-gia-kim, mọi binh lính và mọi nhà lãnh đạo nghe những điều U-ri nói. Vậy vua tìm cách giết U-ri. Nhưng U-ri biết được. Người sợ hãi nên trốn sang Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 여호야김 왕과 그의 모든 용사와 모든 고관이 그의 말을 듣고, 왕이 그를 죽이려고 했다. 그러자 우리야가 [그것을] 듣고 두려워하여 도망해 이집트로 갔다.
ko.B: 여호야김 왕과 그의 모든 용사와 모든 관리가 그의 말을 듣자, 왕은 그를 죽이려고 했다. 그러나 우리야는 그 소식을 듣고 두려워서 이집트로 도망했다.
ko.R: 여호야김 왕과 그의 모든 군인과 모든 지도자가 우리야가 한 말을 들었다. 그래서 왕은 그를 죽이려고 했다. 그러나 우리야는 그 소식을 들었다. 그는 두려워서 이집트로 달아났다.

decisions.choice: his mighty men: the king's warriors, probably his officers and bodyguard
decisions.reason: The word means strong men or heroes, and often the trained fighting men who served a king (2 Samuel 23:8; 1 Kings 1:8).

decisions.choice: he fled to Egypt: Judah was under Egypt's rule at this time
decisions.reason: Pharaoh Necho had put Jehoiakim on the throne and made him pay tribute (2 Kings 23:34-35). Uriah fled to a land where he hoped to be out of reach, but the king's overlord could hand him back.

decisions.choice: the king sought to put him to death: he tried, but Uriah escaped for the time
decisions.reason: The verb "sought" describes the king's intention and the search, before verse 23 tells how he carried it out.

decisions.choice: mighty men (L); warriors (B); soldiers (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word's picture; Balanced and Readable say who these men were.

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (see verse 10).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֛ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יִם אֵ֣ת אֶלְנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־עַכְבּ֛וֹר וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent the king Jehoiakim men [to] Egypt, Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him, to Egypt.

en.L: And King Jehoiakim sent men [to] Egypt, Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him, to Egypt.
en.B: But King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt: Elnathan son of Achbor and others with him went to Egypt.
en.R: But King Jehoiakim sent Elnathan son of Achbor and some other men to Egypt.

es.L: Y el rey Joacim envió hombres [a] Egipto, a Elnatán hijo de Acbor y a otros hombres con él, a Egipto.
es.B: Pero el rey Joacim envió hombres a Egipto: Elnatán hijo de Acbor y otros con él fueron a Egipto.
es.R: Pero el rey Joacim envió a Egipto a Elnatán hijo de Acbor y a algunos otros hombres.

fr.L: Et le roi Joïaqim envoya des hommes [en] Égypte, Elnathan fils d’Akbor et des hommes avec lui, en Égypte.
fr.B: Mais le roi Joïaqim envoya des hommes en Égypte : Elnathan fils d’Akbor, et d’autres avec lui, allèrent en Égypte.
fr.R: Mais le roi Joïaqim a envoyé en Égypte Elnathan, fils d’Akbor, avec d’autres hommes.

sw.L: Naye mfalme Yehoyakimu akatuma watu [mpaka] Misri, Elnathani mwana wa Akbori na watu pamoja naye, mpaka Misri.
sw.B: Lakini Mfalme Yehoyakimu alituma watu Misri: Elnathani mwana wa Akbori na wengine pamoja naye walikwenda Misri.
sw.R: Lakini Mfalme Yehoyakimu alimtuma Elnathani mwana wa Akbori pamoja na watu wengine mpaka Misri.

vi.L: Vua Giê-hô-gia-kim sai người [sang] Ai Cập, là Ên-na-than con trai Ạc-bồ và mấy người cùng đi với ông, sang Ai Cập.
vi.B: Nhưng vua Giê-hô-gia-kim sai người sang Ai Cập: Ên-na-than con trai Ạc-bồ và mấy người khác cùng đi với ông sang Ai Cập.
vi.R: Nhưng vua Giê-hô-gia-kim sai Ên-na-than con trai Ạc-bồ cùng mấy người khác sang Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 여호야김 왕이 사람들을 이집트로, 곧 악볼의 아들 엘라단과 그와 함께한 사람들을 이집트로 보냈다.
ko.B: 그러나 여호야김 왕은 사람들을 이집트로 보냈다. 악볼의 아들 엘라단과 그와 함께한 사람들이 이집트로 갔다.
ko.R: 그러나 여호야김 왕은 악볼의 아들 엘라단과 다른 몇 사람을 이집트로 보냈다.

decisions.choice: Elnathan son of Achbor: one of Jehoiakim's officials
decisions.reason: His father Achbor was one of the men King Josiah sent to inquire about the book of the law (2 Kings 22:12). Elnathan is named again among the officials who heard Baruch read Jeremiah's scroll and who urged the king not to burn it (36:12, 25).

decisions.choice: Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him, to Egypt: part of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Greek translation is shorter here and does not name Elnathan. The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: to Egypt ... to Egypt: the place is named twice
decisions.reason: The sentence names the men sent and then repeats where they went, stressing how far the king would go to reach Uriah.

decisions.choice: went to Egypt (B); to Egypt said once (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps both mentions of Egypt in a natural sentence; Readable says it once.

decisions.choice: "악볼의 아들 엘라단"
decisions.reason: The published forms in 2 Kings 22:12 and 24:8.

source.text: וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת־אוּרִיָּ֜הוּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וַיְבִאֻ֨הוּ֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֖הוּ בֶּחָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־נִבְלָת֔וֹ אֶל־קִבְרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they brought out Uriah from Egypt and brought him to the king Jehoiakim, and he struck him with [the] sword and threw his corpse into [the] graves of [the] sons of the people.

en.L: And they brought Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to King Jehoiakim, and he struck him down with the sword and threw his corpse into the graves of the sons of the people.
en.B: They brought Uriah back from Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who struck him down with the sword and threw his body into the burial ground of the common people.
en.R: They brought Uriah back from Egypt to King Jehoiakim. The king had him killed with a sword. Then he had Uriah's body thrown into the graveyard for ordinary people.

es.L: Y sacaron a Urías de Egipto y lo trajeron al rey Joacim, y él lo hirió a espada y echó su cadáver en los sepulcros de los hijos del pueblo.
es.B: Sacaron a Urías de Egipto y lo llevaron ante el rey Joacim, que lo mató a espada y echó su cuerpo en el cementerio de la gente común.
es.R: Trajeron a Urías de vuelta de Egipto ante el rey Joacim. El rey lo hizo matar a espada. Luego hizo tirar el cuerpo de Urías en el cementerio de la gente común.

fr.L: Et ils firent sortir Urie d’Égypte et l’amenèrent au roi Joïaqim, et il le frappa de l’épée et jeta son cadavre dans les tombes des fils du peuple.
fr.B: Ils ramenèrent Urie d’Égypte et le conduisirent au roi Joïaqim, qui le fit périr par l’épée et jeta son corps dans la fosse commune du peuple.
fr.R: Ils ont ramené Urie d’Égypte au roi Joïaqim. Le roi l’a fait tuer par l’épée. Puis il a fait jeter le corps d’Urie dans le cimetière des gens ordinaires.

sw.L: Nao wakamtoa Uria Misri, wakamleta kwa mfalme Yehoyakimu, naye akampiga kwa upanga, akaitupa maiti yake katika makaburi ya wana wa watu.
sw.B: Walimrudisha Uria kutoka Misri, wakampeleka kwa Mfalme Yehoyakimu, naye akamuua kwa upanga, akaitupa maiti yake katika makaburi ya watu wa kawaida.
sw.R: Walimrudisha Uria kutoka Misri kwa Mfalme Yehoyakimu. Mfalme akaamuru auawe kwa upanga. Kisha akaamuru maiti ya Uria itupwe katika makaburi ya watu wa kawaida.

vi.L: Họ đem U-ri ra khỏi Ai Cập và dẫn người đến vua Giê-hô-gia-kim; vua dùng gươm giết người và quăng xác người vào mồ mả của con cái dân thường.
vi.B: Họ bắt U-ri từ Ai Cập về và dẫn đến vua Giê-hô-gia-kim. Vua dùng gươm giết người và quăng xác người vào bãi tha ma của dân thường.
vi.R: Họ đưa U-ri từ Ai Cập về cho vua Giê-hô-gia-kim. Vua cho dùng gươm giết U-ri. Rồi vua cho ném xác U-ri vào nghĩa địa dành cho người thường dân.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 우리야를 이집트에서 데리고 나와 여호야김 왕에게 데려가자, 그가 칼로 그를 쳐 죽이고 그의 시체를 평민의 자손들의 무덤에 던졌다.
ko.B: 그들은 우리야를 이집트에서 데려와 여호야김 왕에게 넘겼다. 왕은 그를 칼로 쳐 죽이고, 그의 시체를 평민들의 공동묘지에 던져 버렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 우리야를 이집트에서 여호야김 왕에게 데려왔다. 왕은 그를 칼로 죽이게 했다. 그리고 우리야의 시체를 보통 사람들의 무덤에 던져 버리게 했다.

decisions.choice: he struck him with the sword: the king had him executed
decisions.reason: The king is named as the one who struck him, whether by his own hand or by his men's at his order; either way the act was his.

decisions.choice: the graves of the sons of the people: the common burial ground
decisions.reason: "Sons of the people" means ordinary people. A prophet who spoke in the LORD's name was denied a family tomb and thrown among the common graves, as a mark of shame (2 Kings 23:6 speaks of the same burial ground in the Kidron Valley).

decisions.choice: had him killed; had Uriah's body thrown
decisions.reason: Readable says the king ordered it, since a king usually acted through his men (m1).

decisions.choice: the common people (B); ordinary people (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is not a family name but means the ordinary people (m2).

source.text: אַ֗ךְ יַ֚ד אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁפָ֔ן הָיְתָ֖ה אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ לְבִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת־אֹת֥וֹ בְיַד־הָעָ֖ם לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Nevertheless, [the] hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so as not to give him into [the] hand of the people to put him to death.

en.L: Nevertheless, the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so as not to give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
en.B: But Ahikam son of Shaphan stood behind Jeremiah, so Jeremiah was not given into the people's hands to be put to death.
en.R: But Ahikam son of Shaphan protected Jeremiah. So Jeremiah was not handed over to the people to be killed.

es.L: Sin embargo, la mano de Ahicam hijo de Safán estaba con Jeremías, para que no lo entregaran en mano del pueblo para matarlo.
es.B: Pero Ahicam hijo de Safán respaldó a Jeremías, así que Jeremías no fue entregado en manos del pueblo para que lo mataran.
es.R: Pero Ahicam hijo de Safán protegió a Jeremías. Así que Jeremías no fue entregado al pueblo para que lo mataran.

fr.L: Cependant, la main d’Ahiqam fils de Shaphân était avec Jérémie, pour qu’on ne le livre pas entre les mains du peuple pour le faire mourir.
fr.B: Mais Ahiqam fils de Shaphân soutint Jérémie, si bien que Jérémie ne fut pas livré au peuple pour être mis à mort.
fr.R: Mais Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, a protégé Jérémie. Ainsi, Jérémie n’a pas été livré au peuple pour être tué.

sw.L: Lakini mkono wa Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani ulikuwa pamoja na Yeremia, hata asitiwe mikononi mwa watu ili wamwue.
sw.B: Lakini Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani alimtetea Yeremia, kwa hiyo Yeremia hakutiwa mikononi mwa watu ili auawe.
sw.R: Lakini Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani alimlinda Yeremia. Kwa hiyo Yeremia hakukabidhiwa kwa watu ili auawe.

vi.L: Tuy nhiên, tay của A-hi-cam con trai Sa-phan ở cùng Giê-rê-mi, để ông không bị phó vào tay dân chúng mà bị giết.
vi.B: Nhưng A-hi-cam con trai Sa-phan đứng ra bênh vực Giê-rê-mi, nên Giê-rê-mi không bị giao vào tay dân chúng để bị xử tử.
vi.R: Nhưng A-hi-cam con trai Sa-phan đã bảo vệ Giê-rê-mi. Vì vậy Giê-rê-mi không bị giao cho dân chúng giết.

ko.L: 그러나 사반의 아들 아히감의 손이 예레미야와 함께하여, 그를 백성의 손에 넘겨 죽이지 못하게 했다.
ko.B: 그러나 사반의 아들 아히감이 예레미야의 뒤를 지켜 주었으므로, 예레미야는 백성의 손에 넘겨져 죽임을 당하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러나 사반의 아들 아히감이 예레미야를 보호해 주었다. 그래서 예레미야는 백성에게 넘겨져 죽임을 당하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the hand of Ahikam was with Jeremiah: Ahikam used his influence to protect him
decisions.reason: A person's hand being with someone means giving them support and help (1 Samuel 22:17; 2 Samuel 3:12). The verse sets Ahikam's hand against "the hand of the people": one protected, the other would have killed.

decisions.choice: Ahikam son of Shaphan: from a leading family of royal officials
decisions.reason: His father Shaphan was King Josiah's secretary, and Ahikam was one of those Josiah sent to inquire about the book of the law (2 Kings 22:12). Ahikam's son Gedaliah would later be made governor of Judah and look after Jeremiah (39:14; 40:5-6).

decisions.choice: nevertheless: unlike Uriah, Jeremiah was spared
decisions.reason: The small word sets Jeremiah's rescue against Uriah's death (verses 20-23). The danger had not passed with the verdict of verse 16; the people could still have killed him.

decisions.choice: stood behind (B); protected (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m1); Literal keeps the picture of the hand.

decisions.choice: "사반의 아들 아히감"
decisions.reason: The published forms, as 2 Kings 22:12 and the terms note's "사반의 손자 아히감의 아들 그다랴".
